description:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Why we are looking for you

The Strategic Partnership Manager will own and grow one of Owner’s most important strategic referral partnerships with a leading broadline distributor in the United States. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, sales, marketing and operations. They will be responsible for turning a high-potential channel into a predictable, scalable revenue driver.

This role requires someone who combines strategic thinking with relentless execution. The ideal candidate is highly organized, deeply relationship-driven, fluent and unphased with ambiguity, and comfortable navigating both executive-level partnership strategy and day-to-day deal execution. This person loves building from zero to scale, is energized by ambitious revenue goals and ownership, moves quickly and thrives in fast-paced startup environments.

This strategic partnership represents a major growth lever for Owner, and can become one of our most efficient and scalable acquisition channels. This hire will be a driving force in unlocking that potential.

Location & Travel

We’re hiring two (2) Strategic Partnerships Managers to support distinct partner portfolios across the United States. Both positions are 100% remote within the U.S. and require 30%+ travel within their respective regions.

Please Note: We are using this job posting to recruit for both positions. Based on your background, experience, and geographic preference, we’ll determine which partner portfolio and territory best align with your strengths which will be discussed in the interview process. Location coverage below:

  • Midwest & South: Preferred locations include Detroit, Grand Rapids, Indianapolis, Cleveland, Cincinnati, and Columbus.

  • Northeast & Southeast: Preferred locations include Atlanta, Charlotte, Washington, D.C., Philadelphia, and Orlando.


The impact you will have

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a broadline distributor partnership, managing the relationship at both the executive and seller levels

  • Develop and execute strategies to find and build relationships with relevant stakeholders within the partner organization to increase referral volume and downstream revenue

  • Execute best in class enablement by building playbooks, training and collateral to help partner stakeholders effectively position and recommend our product

  • Identify new surfaces and markets within the partnership to drive incremental impact

  • Own partner-sourced pipeline and revenue targets, contributing materially to company ARR

  • Work cross-functionally with curated sales, launch and success teams to ensure extraordinary customer journeys for qualified partner-sourced leads and drive revenue through a structured referral motion

  • Create opportunities to represent Owner at in-person events, including general sales meetings, ride-withs, division food shows, corporate conferences, workshops and more

Who you’ll work with

  • This is an individual contributor manager-level role.

  • This person will report directly to the VP of Partnerships.

  • You'll work closely with our Sales, Onboarding, Customer Success, Enablement, and Marketing teams.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years in partnerships, business development, strategic alliances, or consulting

  • Experience working with, or for, a fast-scaling restaurant technology startup or broadline distributor

  • Proven track record of building partnerships that drive measurable, closed revenue, with strong sales instincts across pipeline, revenue motions, and partner urgency

  • Strong commercial instincts to drive material revenue, not just manage relationships

  • Exceptional relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills with the ability to navigate complex organizations and competing demands

  • Highly organized with strong operational discipline; demonstrated ability to build process and structure in an unstructured external environment

  • Deep familiarity with Salesforce and CRM-driven pipeline management

  • Fluency in the hospitality/restaurant technology ecosystem with genuine empathy for the restaurant operator experience

  • Willingness to travel 30%+ of the time

  • Bonus points: If you're fluent in Spanish and can build relationships with Spanish-speaking partners and customers.

Pay and benefits

  • The OTE for this role is $170,000 USD ($110,000 base + $60,000 variable uncapped) plus a generous pre-IPO equity package.

  • Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.
